description: OpenCEM: Multimodal photovoltaic and battery microgrid dataset with context records and sky imagery is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tinko Sebastian Bartels, Ruixiang Wu (School of Data Science, The Chinese University of Hong Kong-Shenzhen). We present a multimodal dataset from an on-campus photovoltaic and battery microgrid in Shenzhen, China. The release contains 15,543,099 rows from two hybrid inverters, including electrical measurements, operating states, settings, cumulative statistics, specifications, and fault-history arrays. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
